time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame = round(t * fps)
units: pixels (full 4096x2160 resolution, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
description: Close-up of a bathroom vanity between two white vessel basins. A bare hand/forearm (black sleeve) enters from the right, grasps a tall clear rectangular glass perfume bottle by its metal neck, and lifts it straight up (tilting top-right near the end) out of the top of the frame. Everything else is static.

camera.motion: nearly static hand-held/slider drift: background shifts smoothly right and down, total (+23.5, +17.9) px at frame 18 vs frame 0 (about 1.5% of the bottle's travel). No zoom detected.
camera.per_frame_shift_file: tracks/camera_shift.csv (dx_left, dy_left = shift of static background relative to frame 0; to get background-relative positions subtract them)
